chunks: Ajlan narrated to me from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
For the blood-money of a blackened tooth, there is one quarter of the blood-money of the tooth.

key_terms.السِّنِّ: the tooth for which compensation is being assessed
key_terms.الْأَسْوَدِ: blackened, indicating damaged discoloration of the tooth
key_terms.دِيَةِ: financial compensation legally due for bodily injury
key_terms.رُبُعُ: one quarter of the full amount

ai.seo_question: What is the diyah for a blackened tooth in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning compensation for bodily injury. It states that the diyah for a blackened tooth is one quarter of the full diyah of a tooth, indicating a reduced but recognized compensation for partial damage.
